summary: Verified moderation-privacy masking (backend + frontend) and Suspend dialog fix. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests passed in /app/backend/tests/test_moderation_privacy.py covering (a) inbox/threads masks mod sender to 'Support' with empty user_id/avatar and role='support'; (b) /threads/{id}/inbox masks OP + mod replies while keeping suspended user's own messages unmasked; (c) /notifications masks from_user_* and rewrites 'from <name>' titles to 'from Support'; (d) admin GET /threads/{id} is NOT masked; (e) GET /users/{sus_id} returns 404 for self and unauth, 200 for admin (with is_suspended=true); (f) suspended user can reply on own direct thread but gets 403 on public thread; (g) regression admin/login/me + public lists still 200. Frontend: Suspend button in Admin>Users tab opens shadcn Dialog data-testid='suspend-user-dialog' with 7-days default, private reason field and Confirm/Cancel — dialog appears above scrollable list. Suspended user login as targetuser@test.com shows inbox with sender 'Support' (avatar 'S') + 'SUPPORT' badge, no admin identity leak. Thread page shows 'Support' (7 spans, 0 anchors) for OP + mod replies; own replies still show 'Target User'. Navigating /user/{own_id} while suspended correctly redirects to /inbox (SuspendedGuard).
critical_code_review_comments: _mask_notification title rewrite uses simple string partition on 'from ' — if a mod's name legitimately contains ' from ' anywhere else the split would be wrong; acceptable for current title patterns 'New message from X' / 'New reply from X'.

_mask_direct_thread sets user_id='' which the frontend uses to render span vs <a> — cohesive contract but be aware any future code reading user_id as ObjectId would break; recommend documenting this sentinel.
test_credentials: admin@cineverse.com / Admin@123 ; targetuser@test.com / Test@123 (re-suspended 7d via /moderation/users/{id}/suspend during test)
seed_data_creation: Added test messages to the existing direct thread 6abb46e12155d4d16fb8a991 ('another admin reply for masking test', 'notification trigger msg', 'my reply from suspended'). Re-suspended targetuser@test.com for 7 days with reason 'test suspension for masking'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_moderation_privacy.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/test_moderation_privacy.py -o addopts=''` (project pytest.ini forces xdist loadscope which errors on ad-hoc runs; the -o override disables it). Thread message POST endpoint expects field 'text', not 'body'. The suspended user's direct thread id is 6abb46e12155d4d16fb8a991 and it now has 8+ messages including mixed mod and user replies — good regression sample.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration. Previous suspend-button-not-opening-dialog issue is confirmed fixed: the Suspend action now uses a shadcn Dialog (data-testid=suspend-user-dialog) which renders in a portal above the scrollable users list, and cancel/confirm work as expected.
